summary: Quiet campus service road kerb beside a university works yard.
reasons: Backs onto fenced yard and glasshouses
No cars parked here; campus patrols likely

drivers.seclusion: Only university buildings and a works yard nearby; nearest home is the Directors Residence, hundreds of metres off.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed service road open at both ends; narrow footpath strip beside the south kerb, so room to pull off is unclear.
drivers.traffic: Campus delivery and staff traffic by day; quiet at night.
drivers.convention: No cars stop along this kerb; the large lot to the west is where people park.

flags: Lift gates mapped nearby on side access, not on this road
Painted road markings at the east end
sun_shade: Open to the sky; a tree shades the west end in the afternoon.
rubbish: Scrap and dumped material in the yard to the south.
cannot_judge: Campus parking rules and security patrols
Whether the road is wide enough to stop clear of the lane

best_section.where: South kerb of the glasshouse service road, beside the works yard
